authorizing_reference: GitHub issue #28 (public tracker) PART 1 -- probe amendment, pre-registered BEFORE the run, flip-paired at review, per docs/spec/c8-claim-ladder.md (c)/(d) C1 kill-criterion note ("a future candidate that does not reuse that exact pipeline ... would need a matching amendment") + session review-gate assignment 2026-07-03.

changes.reason: Generalize CHK fields 4-5 (ablation_method_blocked / ordinary_runner_intact) from one hardcoded verdict-string pair (contribution_level_deletion_ablation.native_link_verdict == 'NATIVE_OPERATOR_EXTERNAL_TRANSFER_LINK_BLOCKED', external_delegate_verdict == 'D3_MULTI_TASK_GENERALIZATION_PASS') to any pair accepted under four rules: (a) deletion verdict ends _BLOCKED and delegate verdict ends _PASS; (b) BOTH verdicts carry executed-run provenance (a command plus a receipt_ref resolvable on disk, via new fields deletion_run_provenance / delegate_run_provenance); (c) the receipt names the deleted contribution and surviving delegate pipeline explicitly (new fields deleted_contribution / surviving_delegate_pipeline); (d) the incumbent exact-string pair still passes UNCHANGED (backward-compatible shortcut, no new requirement retroactively imposed on the one existing candidate receipt). Implemented as three new module-level functions (_resolves_on_disk, _provenance_ok, _ablation_fields_4_5) replacing the two inline == comparisons; nothing else in the file changes.
